title: App Experience Analyst
description:
Life Pharmacy is the UAE’s largest retail pharmacy chain, with 600+ stores. It runs the region’s No. 1 pharmacy app, which serves thousands of customers every day with medicines, wellness, beauty and fast home delivery. Life Pharmacy is part of Life Group, which also includes Life Medical Centre and Life GP Clinics.

**The role**

We’re looking for someone whose full-time job is to use the Life Pharmacy app as our most demanding customer would. You’ll find what’s broken, confusing or costing us sales, and turn it into clear recommendations that our product and tech teams act on. You’ll report directly to the Head of eCommerce in Dubai.

**What you’ll do**

* Test the core app journeys daily on iOS, Android and web: search, product pages, cart, checkout, prescription upload, Click & Collect and order tracking
* Check our top-searched products every day for correct results, pricing, offers and stock
* Benchmark Life Pharmacy against leading UAE apps such as Noon, Amazon, Talabat and InstaShop
* Track app store reviews and spot recurring customer pain points
* Test every new app release and campaign before and after launch
* Send a weekly report of the top 10 issues and ideas, ranked by customer and sales impact

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–4 years in e-commerce app QA, UX research, product operations or catalog quality
* A sharp eye for detail: you notice a wrong price or a broken filter before anyone else
* Clear, structured written English, with screenshots, impact and a suggested fix for every finding
* A heavy user of shopping and delivery apps who naturally compares experiences
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets, Jira or similar trackers, and screen recording tools

**Nice to have**

* B.Pharm or a pharmacy background
* Experience with UAE or GCC shopping apps
* A basic understanding of app analytics: funnels, conversion and search data

title: PHP-Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead software engineering teams, optimize delivery processes, and drive people development across multiple product teams. The role primarily focuses on engineering team management, delivery excellence, Agile execution, and stakeholder collaboration rather than hands-on development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage software engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Drive sprint planning, roadmap execution, delivery tracking, and risk management.
* Coach engineers and Technical Leads, manage performance, and support career development.
* Monitor engineering KPIs, including DORA and SPACE metrics, to improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Establish effective Agile practices, CI/CD workflows, release governance, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and delivery blockers.
* Promote team engagement, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven engineering management experience, including managing teams of 5+ engineers.
* Strong people leadership, mentoring, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics, engineering delivery KPIs, CI/CD, and software release processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, delivery commitments, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong communication and distributed-team management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Previous experience in software development or technical leadership.
* Familiarity with PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, or API gateways.
* Experience with SaaS products, API-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of SRE, platform reliability, and engineering process transformation.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Support project success by coordinating tasks, managing schedules, and ensuring smooth communication between teams and clients. The Project Coordinator role is designed to provide practical exposure to project management processes within software development. Responsibilities include assisting project managers in planning, execution, and delivery of projects while maintaining accurate records and timelines. This position requires strong organizational ability, clear communication, and problem‑solving skills to ensure projects progress efficiently in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Communicate effectively with development teams and clients to ensure clarity in requirements and updates
* Conduct research and gather data to support project development and decision‑making
* Assist project managers with planning, coordination, and execution of tasks
* Maintain project schedules, timelines, and documentation for smooth tracking
* Coordinate meetings, daily stand‑ups, and team activities to keep progress aligned
* Monitor and track project budgets and expenses with accuracy
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including development and design for seamless delivery
* Prepare and maintain daily reports to support transparency and accountability


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (BCA, MCA, BSc Computer Science, B‑Tech in CS)
* 1 year of relevant experience.
* Internship experience in frontend development or a relevant field preferred
* Strong communication skills in English with interpersonal effectiveness
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail
